top.line: A reply to Nina J.: governance is in our smallest offer, and even the £0 one, because it is all open source.
top.para: And why that helps pilots convert.

in-short.line: Governance included; small experiments are not small risks; £0 has it all; we sell trust, not controls.

comment.line: Nina J.'s comment and my reply on the post about our stack of companies.
comment.para: "We're only testing it" does not reassure.

risk.line: What the agent can reach, what it was asked, who can stop it: none shrinks with a small pilot.
risk.para: Key, policy and stop from day one.

open.line: Nothing proprietary, so nothing to gate: policies, vaults, keys and SHarness are all public.

upgrade.line: Much of software sells single sign-on and audit logs as the top tier; with agents that is worse.

ladder.line: From £0 to £20,000 the controls are the same; we sell time, setup, judgement and a signature.

convert.line: Pilots die at the security review; one with its governance built in walks in with its evidence.

limits.line: Free code is not free work; prices are proposals; pilots are Nina's field.

sources.line: The comment, open-source.sgit.ai, sso.tax, abp.sgit.ai and earlier articles.
